capabilities: embed GitHub Gist and OpenGist snippets in codeblocks with syntax highlighting
upload notes as public or secret gists and update them manually or on autosave
browse and edit gists through an integrated browser with sign-in
embed any website with zoom, height, and CSS overrides
target individual files within multi-file gists
extras: Full documentation is hosted separately via MkDocs; the README covers usage but points there for the complete feature and properties list.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display GitHub Gist or OpenGist snippets in notes or to publish notes as gists.

relations.evidence: A plugin for Obsidian.md which allows you to create, convert, and update notes from Obsidian to Github
thomiceli  over at OpenGist for implementing the JSON functionality request
linjunpop for developing the first Obsidian Gist plugin. It was a top choice

summary: GitHub Gist and OpenGist client that embeds gists in notes, uploads notes as gists, and embeds websites in an integrated browser.
